name: Antonio
source: Antonio is one of the three High Council members that serve King Lucius. He was born into an influential vampire family and is a skilled infiltrator. Surprisingly, he is one of the few vampires that doesn't particularly enjoy drinking blood. He also doesn't like fighting, but when he does he goes into a berserker rage.
